v_Ready.label: Ready
v_Ready.check: Every transaction on the switch and both hosts match what the oracle expects.

v_Approved.label: Approved
v_Approved.check: The followed transaction is APPROVED and unsettled on the switch, and every other transaction and host still matches.

v_Reversed.label: Reversed
v_Reversed.check: The reversal reached the issuer: status REVERSED, and nothing else changed unexpectedly.

v_ReversalPending.label: Reversal pending
v_ReversalPending.check: The reversal is queued for store and forward because its host was unreachable.

v_Settled.label: Settled
v_Settled.check: The transaction is in a closed batch and can no longer be reversed.

v_Declined.label: Declined
v_Declined.check: The transaction is DECLINED with the expected response code and routing attempts.

e_Start: Reset the switch and set both hosts up.
e_Purchase: Visa purchase with a new STAN. Expect 00 from host-a, or from host-c if host-a is down or timing out.
e_Refund: Refund with a new STAN. Routed the same way as a purchase.
e_PurchaseInsufficientFunds: Amount ending in 51. Expect decline 51 from whichever host answers.
e_PurchaseNoHost: Expect decline 91, with both failed attempts recorded.
e_Resend: Same terminal and STAN again. Expect the original transaction back with duplicate: true, never a new charge.
e_CloseBatch: Expect totals for exactly the approved, unsettled transactions, or 409 when there are none.
e_RetryReversals: Expect exactly the queued reversals whose host is up to be delivered.
e_NextTransaction: Stop following this one. It stays on the switch and is still checked.

effects.approvedBy = hostA == 'up' ? 'host-a' :: remember the approving host: host-a if up, otherwise host-c

reverseInPlace.v_Reversed: No change: repeating a reversal is safe.
reverseInPlace.v_ReversalPending: No change: it stays queued until a retry.
reverseInPlace.v_Declined: Refused with 409: only approved transactions can be reversed.
reverseInPlace.v_Settled: Refused with 409: after settlement a refund is the right path.
